name: A Study on Temporal EEG Interconnection
description: In this independent research project, I explore the statistics of temporal EEG signal connectivity to develop a better understanding of how different regions of the brain communicate.

name: A Contemporary Review of Neural Ensembles
description: This bibliometric analysis focuses on recent (2000-2025) research regarding neural ensembles to summarize our understanding of how groups of neurons coordinate to process information in the brain.
